claims.text: The semantic tagset consists of 80 semantic tags grouped in 13 coarse-grained classes.
The semantic tagset is designed to assign language-neutral semantic categories to words, overcoming limitations of traditional part-of-speech tagsets.
The semantic tags are used in conjunction with a bi-LSTM model for semantic tagging tasks.
